desc: S1 gr1 intent-probe (CACHE-ONLY, gating). Load analysis/output/visual_sep_gr1/cache.npz. For each representation in {raw flattened [16xD], PCA-k with k matched to latent budget 64*16, v3 latent Z3, v4 latent Z4mu}: train linear (sklearn LogisticRegression) AND 2-layer MLP probe to predict the 24 gr1 task labels, with a BY-EPISODE train/val split (never chunk-level; group by episode/task id to avoid leakage). Report chance-normalized accuracy CNA = (acc-chance)/(1-chance), chance=1/24, and macro-F1. Fills S1 gr1 placeholders: s1-lin-gr1-{raw,pca,v3,v4}, s1-mlp-gr1-{raw,pca,v3,v4}, s1-f1-gr1-{raw,v4}, s1-perdim-gr1 (best single raw dim CNA), s1-ntask-gr1=24. ALSO run the SAME probe on the dexjoco cache as the disjoint-action CONTROL -> fills s1-{lin,mlp}-dex-{raw,pca,v3,v4}, s1-ntask-dex=5 (expect ~ceiling, raw~=v4, off-curve). Write results+run_meta.json (git commit, exact cmd, seed) under .autoresearch/results/<expid>/. CPU-only, env gr00t-actlat, export OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS/NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=8.

S4 semantic-geometry (CACHE-ONLY). On analysis/output/visual_sep_gr1/cache.npz (gr1, 24 tasks) AND the dexjoco cache, for each representation {raw flat, PCA-k (k=latent budget), v3 Z3, v4 Z4mu}: (a) NN retrieval precision@k by TASK label (query a chunk, retrieve k nearest by cosine/L2 in that rep, precision = frac of same-task neighbors), report P@1/P@5/P@10; (b) unsupervised clustering (KMeans with n_clusters=#tasks, and/or agglomerative) then NMI and ARI vs task labels. Report a raw/PCA/v3/v4 table per dataset. Frame prior finding as evidence: gr1 raw-action clusters barely match task (ARI~0.05) = low semantic geometry in raw. Placeholder IDs for S4 are still being drafted by Writing — record results in .autoresearch/results/<expid>/ keyed by (dataset,rep,metric); Writing will map to placeholders. run_meta.json required. CPU-only, gr00t-actlat, thread caps=8.

S2 effective-DoF metrics (CACHE-ONLY). On gr1 cache (analysis/output/visual_sep_gr1/cache.npz) and dexjoco cache: for RAW actions compute nominal DoF (D) vs effective DoF = participation ratio PR=(sum lambda_i)^2/sum(lambda_i^2) and n_pc95 (#PCs for 95% var) from the action covariance; report per dataset. Also intent-variance decomposition: fraction of raw-action variance that is task-predictive = between-task var / total var, and how it grows with PCA rank (per-rank cumulative). This quantifies redundancy motivating compression. Also report same PR/n_pc95 for v3 and v4 latents for comparison. desc: S3 label-noise / copycat-shortcut (CACHE-ONLY, gr1 + dexjoco caches). Three parts: (a) SPECTRAL/JERK: per action-dim high-frequency energy (e.g. fraction of power above mid-band, and mean squared jerk = 2nd difference) of RAW actions vs the tokenizer RECONSTRUCTION (decode Z4 -> a_hat via the decoder; CPU forward, no GPU). Hypothesis: recon has less high-freq/jerk = denoising evidence. Report raw vs recon HF-energy & jerk per dataset. (b) BLIND PREDICTABILITY (copycat): within an episode, predict the action chunk a_t from action HISTORY alone (previous chunk(s)) using ridge regression; report history-only R² for RAW action targets vs LATENT (Z4) targets. High raw R² = copycat/shortcut-prone supervision (cite copycat/causal-confusion). (c) TEMPORAL AUTOCORRELATION: mean autocorrelation vs lag of raw action token sequences vs latent (Z3/Z4) token sequences. S2 WITHIN-EMBODIMENT intent control (CACHE-ONLY, gr1). Kills the dataset confound: same gr1 episodes + same LOEPTO leak-free split as exp-0001, vary ONLY the action representation fed to the intent probe (24 tasks, chance-normalized acc): (a) ARM-ONLY action-dim subset, (b) FULL body+hands (all 29 dims = the exp-0001 raw baseline), (c) TOP-K effective PCs (k = n_pc95 ≈ 6, and a couple nearby k). Requires the gr1 action-dim layout (which of the 29 dims are arm vs waist/torso vs hands/neck) — infer from the gr00t gr1 embodiment schema / dataset modality config; if ambiguous, report the grouping you used. Deliverable: CNA(arm-only) vs CNA(full) vs CNA(top-k PCs) on identical episodes — isolates whether intent lives in a low-eff-dim subspace and whether extra body DoF adds or dilutes intent signal. Reuse analysis/intent_probe.py probe + split. Results under .autoresearch/results/<expid>/ + run_meta. CPU-only, gr00t-actlat, thread caps=8.

claim: S3 copycat/label-noise (gr1): raw action chunks are highly predictable from action history alone (blind ridge R² 0.980), and v3 is too (0.982) — so pure compression doesn't reduce copycat-predictability; but v4 drops to 0.915, is ~3× harder to naive-copy (NMSE 0.104 vs raw 0.035), and has lower temporal autocorrelation (lag1 0.941 vs raw/v3 ~0.99). Also v4 has whiter spectrum (low-freq power frac 0.387 vs raw 0.600). The 'denoising=smoother' hypothesis is REFUTED (v4 reconstruction HF-frac ratio 1.56× raw, not smoother; decode L1 0.0014) → reframed as spectral de-correlation. Conclusion: v4 is a less copycat/shortcut-prone SUPERVISION target. Numbers in .autoresearch/results/exp-0004/cacheonly_gr1.json (signals) + recon_gr1.json.
